name: Martial Bond (Combat)
body:
You can channel the abilities of a weapon through your unarmed strikes.

Prerequisite(s): Improved Unarmed Strike.

Benefit(s): You can select 1 melee weapon, forming a bond with it over 24 hours. Once you do so, your unarmed strikes are treated as though they possessed all magical enhancements of the bonded weapon. Any enhancement which would be an invalid choice for an unarmed strike (such as returning) does not function with this ability. You must be within 5 ft. of your bonded weapon at all times to benefit from this feat, and you can select a new weapon with which to bond by spending another 24 hours bonding with it, breaking your previous bond.
